digest.component_or_area: pending-binding recovery gate in outbound diff reconciliation
propositions: preview and legacy --mode dry-run passes (persist=False) perform remote add_label and set_entity_property calls during pending-binding recovery despite being documented as no-write

the recovery gate in run_differs._run_differs_outbound gates only on 'if not scoped_ids' without checking the persist axis, unlike the sibling invariant-filing gate which gates on (not persist) or bool(scoped_ids)
the local binding-store save is correctly suppressed on no-write passes but the remote keyed-pending label and entity-property writes proceed unconditionally
the fix gates recovery on 'if not scoped_ids and ctx.persist' to suppress remote writes on preview while keeping live-pass recovery unchanged
a keyed-pending binding on a no-write pass must perform zero remote add_label and set_entity_property mutations and a live pass must still trigger recovery
